blocks.text: Class, mark and variant: the three traits of every warship.

Every warship has three traits: its CLASS (the hull, for life), its MARK (how refined, from Warships research) and its VARIANT (its specialty, picked at the Shipyard). A Mk IV Breacher Cruiser is all three.
A new mark upgrades every ship of that class at once, including those already built; class and variant never change once a ship is built.
